boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented University of Richmond study environments, including current renovation and access considerations.

cards.title: Boatwright Ground Floor
cards.subtitle: Boatwright Memorial Library · Ground Level
cards.notes: Use the reopened ground floor for individual work, then check the library’s current hours before heading over during renovation.
cards.short_summary: An open Boatwright level with documented student study seating.
cards.evidence_claim: Boatwright’s ground floor is open during construction, and the library’s renovation page includes photos of students studying there.
cards.access_notes: The ground floor is open during construction; the posted library schedule lists weekday hours and closure on weekends. Check the page before visiting.

cards.title: Boatwright Basement Level
cards.subtitle: Boatwright Memorial Library · Basement
cards.notes: Set up in the open basement level, and plan an accessible route in advance because the basement elevator is reported unavailable through fall 2026.
cards.short_summary: An open Boatwright level planned around stacks, study carrels, and group rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: Boatwright’s basement level is open during construction; the renovation plan identifies its Warehouse District for book stacks, study carrels, and group study rooms.
cards.access_notes: Open during construction. The library reports the basement elevator is non-operational through fall 2026; request assistance at the ground-level desk if needed.

cards.title: Warehouse District Study Carrels
cards.subtitle: Boatwright Memorial Library · Basement Level
cards.notes: Choose a carrel-style setup when you want a defined work surface; confirm the current floor layout or availability with library staff.
cards.short_summary: Carrels are part of Boatwright’s basement-focused study plan.
cards.evidence_claim: The renovation plan states that Boatwright’s basement Warehouse District will house traditional library functions including study carrels.
cards.access_notes: The basement level is open during construction, but renovation may affect exact layout; contact the library for current availability.

cards.title: Boatwright Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Boatwright Memorial Library
cards.notes: Reserve ahead through LibCal for a group session, and select a room/time slot that matches your team’s planned work.
cards.short_summary: Reservable rooms for collaborative academic work.
cards.evidence_claim: Boatwright provides 11 group study rooms, primarily for student use, with self-scheduled reservations through LibCal.
cards.access_notes: Reservations are self-scheduled through LibCal. Current construction may affect room availability; verify while booking.

cards.title: Boatwright Individual Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Boatwright Memorial Library
cards.notes: Book an individual room through LibCal when you need a contained workspace, then verify its assigned floor before leaving.
cards.short_summary: Reservable solo rooms primarily intended for students.
cards.evidence_claim: Boatwright provides eight individual study rooms, primarily for student use, and reservations are self-scheduled through LibCal.
cards.access_notes: Self-scheduled through LibCal; faculty and staff may reserve rooms during daytime hours. Confirm current availability when booking.

cards.title: Discovery District
cards.subtitle: Boatwright Memorial Library · First Floor
cards.notes: Plan this for a later-semester work session centered on academic support and technology resources; first-floor reopening is scheduled for fall 2026.
cards.short_summary: A future first-floor academic-support and technology hub.
cards.evidence_claim: Boatwright’s renovation plan identifies the first-floor Discovery District as a hub for academic support and technology resources, including research librarians and the Weinstein Learning Center.
cards.access_notes: The first floor remains under renovation and is scheduled to reopen in fall 2026; it is not a current walk-in study option.

cards.title: Conservatory District
cards.subtitle: Boatwright Memorial Library · Second Floor
cards.notes: Save this quiet-study option for after the second-floor reopening, and use the library’s current study-space guide for an interim location.
cards.short_summary: A planned quiet-study floor with digital scholarship resources.
cards.evidence_claim: Boatwright’s renovation plan says the second-floor Conservatory District will offer quiet study areas and house digital scholarship.
cards.access_notes: The second floor is under renovation and scheduled to reopen in fall 2026; use the library’s study-space guide for current alternatives.

cards.entity_name: Carole and Marcus Weinstein Learning Center
cards.title: Weinstein Learning Center
cards.subtitle: Boatwright complex · Academic-support space
cards.notes: Bring a draft, problem set, or project question and pair study time with the center’s tutoring, coaching, writing, or technology services.
cards.short_summary: A collaborative learning center combining several academic-support services.
cards.evidence_claim: The Weinstein Learning Center is a collaborative intellectual gathering space supporting students and co-locating tutoring, coaching, writing, technology, and related services.
cards.access_notes: During Boatwright construction, the WLC is listed among adjacent units accessible through the Boatwright Tower and Administrative Wing entrances; check service hours before visiting.

cards.title: Parsons Music Library
cards.subtitle: Modlin Center for the Arts · 453 Westhampton Way
cards.notes: Use the expanded seating area for reading or media-supported work, and enter via Booker Hall’s second floor or Modlin’s third floor.
cards.short_summary: A music-library study area with broad seating and media resources.
cards.evidence_claim: Parsons Music Library has a greatly enlarged study area with many seating options and offers laptops, iPads, printing, copying, and scanning.
cards.access_notes: The library states it is available to all UR students, faculty, and staff; community visitors are welcome. Its posted summer 2026 hours are Monday–Friday, 9 a.m.–1 p.m.

cards.title: Research & Collaborative Study Area
cards.subtitle: Boatwright Memorial Library · First Floor
cards.notes: Use this designated low-voice environment for research work with partners, but postpone it until the first floor reopens after renovation.
cards.short_summary: A specifically designated collaborative study zone near research services.
cards.evidence_claim: Boatwright’s study-zones guide lists the first-floor Research and Collaborative Study Area as a collaborative zone where low voices are expected.
cards.access_notes: This first-floor space is currently affected by Boatwright’s renovation; the university says first and second floors will reopen in fall 2026.

warnings: Boatwright Memorial Library is under renovation. Its ground and basement floors are open; first and second floors are scheduled to reopen in fall 2026. Verify current access before visiting.
